description: Off-by-one error in the loop starting index, skipping the first option character after the hyphen.
Wrong comparison operator in argument check, preventing remaining characters from being added as a separate token if the length matches (i + 1).
Swapping the true and false branch actions when an unknown option is encountered and stopAtNonOption is set.
Wrong variable added to the tokens list when an unknown option is encountered and stopAtNonOption is false, adding the whole token instead of just the single character.
Missing assignment of currentOption when a valid option is matched, leaving currentOption stale or unupdated.
